D02-26.why: Neither the given text nor Subpart CC or 1910.179/.180/.184, as I know them, sets a blood pressure cutoff or any medication disqualification for crane operators.

D02-16.why: Neither the text nor Subpart CC gives an extension-ladder height above a landing; that rule is in Subpart X. CC's ladder and access provisions in 1926.1423 don't answer it.

D02-17.why: Cal/OSHA Title 8 card requirements aren't in the sources. Federal 1926.1427 can't say what California requires.

D02-18.why: 1926.1427 sets general certification and practical test criteria, but nothing on NCCCO corridor point deductions or its fail threshold.

D02-19.why: Ontario clearance distances are Canadian law. US Table A doesn't answer the question there.

D02-20.why: NYC DOB Class C license prerequisites are local rules that aren't in the sources.

D02-21.why: LOLER thorough examination intervals are UK law. The US 12-month inspection rule doesn't answer it.

D02-22.why: EM 385-1-1 requirements aren't in the sources. The load test percentages in 1910.179 and .180 don't say what that manual requires for a crawler on a USACE job.

D02-23.why: Bechtel's internal critical lift threshold isn't in the sources. The 75% weight-verification trigger in 1926.1417(o) isn't a critical lift definition.

D02-24.why: The regulatory text doesn't say anything about upcoming changes to the operator certification rules.

D02-25.why: The sources give no annual count of crane-related power line fatalities.
